from typing import Literal
import mas_operators as operator
from . import prompt as prompt_custom
from scripts.async_llm import create_llm_instance


from scripts.evaluator import DatasetType

class Workflow:
    def __init__(
        self,
        name: str,
        llm_config,
        dataset: DatasetType,
        aggregator_llm_config=None,
    ) -> None:
        self.name = name
        self.dataset = dataset
        self.llm = create_llm_instance(llm_config)
        self.aggregator_llm = create_llm_instance(aggregator_llm_config) if aggregator_llm_config else self.llm

    async def __call__(self, problem: str):
        debate = operator.Debate(
            worker_llm=self.llm,
            aggregator_llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_agents=3,
            n_rounds=2,
            worker_prompts=["Solve the Slant puzzle carefully. First infer local constraints from the numbered intersections, then compare with peer proposals and revise toward better numbered-intersection satisfaction. Do not default to symmetric alternating/checkerboard patterns unless forced by the clues. Output a candidate 6x6 grid using only 1 and -1. Problem:\n{problem}\n\nOther proposals:\n{all_proposals}"] * 3,
            aggregator_prompt="You are combining debated Slant candidates.\nProblem:\n{problem}\n\nAll proposals:\n{all_proposals}\n\nChoose or repair the candidate that best satisfies numbered intersections. Treat repetitive alternating/checkerboard structure as a likely failure mode unless strongly supported by the clues. Use loop avoidance only as a secondary criterion. Output only a 6x6 grid using 1 for / and -1 for \\."
        )
        draft = await debate(problem)
        seq = operator.Sequential(
            llm=self.aggregator_llm,
            num_rounds=1,
            prompts=[prompt_custom.SLANT_FINAL_FORMAT_PROMPT + "\n\nProblem:\n{problem}\n\nDraft solution:\n{previous_output}"],
        )
        solution = await seq(draft["response"])
        return solution["response"], {
            "worker": self.llm.get_usage_delta(),
            "aggregator": self.aggregator_llm.get_usage_delta(),
        }
